name: Sankey Chart
description: A flow diagram in a card: nodes as short bars, flows as tinted bands, and each node labelled with its share.

props.name: nodes
props.type: { id: string; name?: string; color?: string }[]
props.description: Every node, in the order they stack top to bottom within their column. Nodes that send flows take the chart palette in turn; end nodes are ink unless given a colour.

props.name: links
props.type: { source: string; target: string; value: number }[]
props.description: Flows between nodes by id. Each band is as thick as its value and tinted with its source's colour.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the labels and tooltip, e.g. (v) => `${v} h`. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in pixels. The width follows the card.

props.name: nodeWidth
props.description: Width of each node bar in pixels.

props.name: nodePadding
props.description: Least vertical gap between nodes in a column.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: caption
props.description: Muted text after the value, e.g. "this week".

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: action
props.description: A control on the right of the header.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts note, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
